title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
taper: From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording that captures the historic first performances of Truckin', Ripple, Brokedown Palace and Operator with crystal‑clear transfer.
ai_review.review: These reviews celebrate a landmark 1970 show where several Dead classics made their debut. The audience source has been lovingly transferred, delivering surprisingly clear and detailed sound for a tape of this age. The performance itself is hailed as epic in Dead history, making the recording a must‑listen for any fan.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers give very high star ratings and praise both the historic significance of the show and the surprisingly excellent audience transfer, indicating a top‑tier musical performance paired with excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No soundboard; pure audience tape but transferred with great care—clear, detailed, and surprisingly crisp for a 1970 audience recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑summer 1970 set flows from acoustic material into electric breakthroughs, showcasing the debut of several future classics and delivering an epic, historic performance.
